visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and bangs is shown in a close-up and medium shot. She is wearing a dark grey collared shirt and holds a large pink commemorative box. The box is adorned with various stickers including a grumpy bear, cats, and logos. The background is a green fabric couch in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) The scene cuts to a theatrical stage. The woman is performing in a white tank top and trousers. She is seen bowing and smiling under vibrant purple and blue stage lights. Other performers in colorful costumes are briefly visible beside her, creating a professional performance atmosphere. (3) A vertical smartphone interface is shown, displaying social media stories with text tags like "@yuniko0720". The background of the phone screen shows a group of people on a stage, indicating a community or fan interaction context. (4) The video focuses on a detailed product demonstration. Hands are seen opening the pink box, which opens like a gaming console. Inside, there is an acrylic stand featuring character art, a Blu-ray disc in a blue case, a wooden USB drive, and an instruction booklet. The woman demonstrates how to disassemble the internal foam packaging to access the USB drive without damaging the box, using close-up shots of her hands.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我與你們的大冒險. [Logo]: @yuniko0720. (2) [Slogan]: 小熊十週年舞台劇 BD+USB 現貨開賣. (3) [Subtitle]: 去年呢 我做了實況十週年的紀念舞台劇 2000多張票 全數完售 非常的感謝大家 這畢竟呢算是我給觀眾的感謝信 加上我的人生回憶. (4) [Variety]: ✨全數完售✨. (5) [Subtitle]: 花了一年努力設計出來 絕對可以好好的收藏 首先外觀是筆電的設計 (其實想做NDS) 上面印刷是10年來的回憶做成的拼貼風格 是不是超級可愛 盒子是磁吸的 打開來會是遊戲主機的感覺 這一塊呢 是舞台劇主視覺的壓克力立牌 可以整片拆下來 接著把上面這一層掀開 會是舞台劇的藍光BD 家裡如果有ps4的話 就可以直接放進去看喔 那沒有的話呢 我們有附上插電腦就可以看的 超級有質感的小木質USB 這是USB的使用說明書 裡面是壓克力牌的底座喔 藍光BD裡面有縮小的節目冊 每一盒都還會再附上一張小卡. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後小小的提醒 當時這個隨身碟的洞 我挖得有點太剛好了 真的很抱歉 建議大家拿出來之後呢 可以把整塊底版拿起來 從後面拿放USB 比較不會傷到盒子喔 最後附上售後服務 畢竟大家是不同階段認識我的 買回去如果有一兩個不知道的梗的話 歡迎私訊我看不懂的地方 我會替你解答喔 但我相信這一部呢 不管是新朋友還是舊朋友 都會有不同的視角 歡迎大家一起加入 我與你們的大冒險吧
